sentences.hanzi: 立冬前一天，小明和丽丽在家里帮妈妈包饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Lìdōng qián yī tiān, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì zài jiā lǐ bāng māma bāo jiǎozi.
sentences.english: The day before Lidong, Xiaoming and Lili helped Mom make dumplings at home.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈已经把饺子皮和肉馅都准备好了。
sentences.pinyin: Māma yǐjīng bǎ jiǎozi pí hé ròuxiàn dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentences.english: Mom had already prepared the dumpling wrappers and meat filling.

sentences.hanzi: 小明洗了手，拿起一张饺子皮，放了一点肉馅。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xǐ le shǒu, ná qǐ yī zhāng jiǎozi pí, fàng le yī diǎn ròuxiàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming washed his hands, picked up a dumpling wrapper, and put a little meat filling on it.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他的饺子包得不太好看，丽丽笑着说：“你包的饺子像个小包子！”
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì tā de jiǎozi bāo de bù tài hǎokàn, Lìlì xiào zhe shuō: "Nǐ bāo de jiǎozi xiàng gè xiǎo bāozi!"
sentences.english: But his dumpling didn't look very nice, and Lili said with a laugh, "Your dumplings look like little steamed buns!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明不好意思地说：“我第一次包，还不太会。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng bù hǎoyìsi de shuō: "Wǒ dì yī cì bāo, hái bù tài huì."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said sheepishly, "This is my first time making them, and I'm not very good at it yet."

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈笑着说：“没关系，多包几个就会了。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma xiào zhe shuō: "Méi guānxi, duō bāo jǐ gè jiù huì le."
sentences.english: Mom said with a smile, "It doesn't matter. Make a few more and you'll get the hang of it."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽包得又快又好，她还教小明怎么把饺子边捏紧。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì bāo de yòu kuài yòu hǎo, tā hái jiāo Xiǎomíng zěnme bǎ jiǎozi biān niē jǐn.
sentences.english: Lili made them quickly and well, and she also taught Xiaoming how to pinch the edges of the dumplings tightly.

sentences.hanzi: 包完饺子后，妈妈做了热汤，厨房里都是暖和的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Bāo wán jiǎozi hòu, māma zuò le rè tāng, chúfáng lǐ dōu shì nuǎnhuo de wèidào.
sentences.english: After they finished wrapping the dumplings, Mom made hot soup, and the kitchen was filled with warm smells.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸回来了，一家人坐在桌子旁边准备吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba huí lái le, yī jiā rén zuò zài zhuōzi pángbiān zhǔnbèi chīfàn.
sentences.english: Dad came home, and the whole family sat at the table, ready to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸对小明和丽丽说：“明天就是立冬了，立冬是冬天的开始。吃饺子可以保暖，所以立冬前我们包饺子吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba duì Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì shuō: "Míngtiān jiù shì Lìdōng le, Lìdōng shì dōngtiān de kāishǐ. Chī jiǎozi kěyǐ bǎonuǎn, suǒyǐ Lìdōng qián wǒmen bāo jiǎozi chī."
sentences.english: Dad said to Xiaoming and Lili, "Tomorrow is Lidong, the beginning of winter. Eating dumplings can keep you warm, so we make and eat dumplings before Lidong."

sentences.hanzi: 小明问：“爸爸，那冬天我们还应该做什么呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: "Bàba, nà dōngtiān wǒmen hái yīnggāi zuò shénme ne?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, "Dad, what else should we do in winter then?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“冬天要多喝热汤，还要穿暖和的衣服，这样身体才会好。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: "Dōngtiān yào duō hē rè tāng, hái yào chuān nuǎnhuo de yīfu, zhèyàng shēntǐ cái huì hǎo."
sentences.english: Dad said, "In winter, you should drink more hot soup and wear warm clothes, so that your bodies will stay healthy."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我最喜欢喝热汤了，冬天我要每天喝一碗！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hē rè tāng le, dōngtiān wǒ yào měi tiān hē yī wǎn!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "I like hot soup the most. In winter, I want to drink a bowl every day!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明也说：“我也要穿妈妈织的毛衣，一定很暖和。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě shuō: "Wǒ yě yào chuān māma zhī de máoyī, yīdìng hěn nuǎnhuo."
sentences.english: Xiaoming also said, "I also want to wear the sweater Mom knitted. It must be very warm."

sentences.hanzi: 饺子煮好了，妈妈把热乎乎的饺子端到桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎozi zhǔ hǎo le, māma bǎ rèhūhū de jiǎozi duān dào zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: The dumplings were cooked, and Mom brought the steaming dumplings to the table.

sentences.hanzi: 一家人一边吃饺子，一边喝热汤，说说笑笑，心里都很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Yī jiā rén yībiān chī jiǎozi, yībiān hē rè tāng, shuōshuōxiàoxiào, xīn lǐ dōu hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: The family ate dumplings and drank hot soup, chatting and laughing, and everyone felt very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 小明吃了一个饺子，高兴地说：“我觉得冬天也很温暖！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng chī le yī gè jiǎozi, gāoxìng de shuō: "Wǒ juéde dōngtiān yě hěn wēnnuǎn!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming ate a dumpling and said happily, "I think winter is also very warm!"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽点点头，说：“对，和家人在一起，冬天也不冷。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì diǎndiǎn tóu, shuō: "Duì, hé jiārén zài yīqǐ, dōngtiān yě bù lěng."
sentences.english: Lili nodded and said, "Right. When we're with family, winter isn't cold."

sentences.hanzi: 吃完饭后，小明和丽丽帮妈妈洗碗，爸爸准备了热水。
sentences.pinyin: Chī wán fàn hòu, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì bāng māma xǐ wǎn, bàba zhǔnbèi le rè shuǐ.
sentences.english: After dinner, Xiaoming and Lili helped Mom wash the dishes, and Dad prepared hot water.

sentences.hanzi: 外面的风很大，可是家里又暖和又幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, kěshì jiā lǐ yòu nuǎnhuo yòu xìngfú.
sentences.english: The wind outside was strong, but the house was warm and filled with happiness.

sentences.hanzi: 他们一起计划着：冬天要常常喝热汤，多穿衣服，还要多运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ jìhuà zhe: dōngtiān yào chángcháng hē rè tāng, duō chuān yīfu, hái yào duō yùndòng.
sentences.english: Together they planned: in winter, they would often drink hot soup, wear more clothes, and exercise more.

sentences.hanzi: 这个立冬前的晚上，一家人过得特别开心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège Lìdōng qián de wǎnshang, yī jiā rén guò de tèbié kāixīn.
sentences.english: On this evening before Lidong, the family had a particularly happy time.
